company.name: CircuitHub
company.shortDescription: CircuitHub provides on-demand electronics manufacturing services for printed circuit board assembly and hardware production workflows.
company.description: CircuitHub provides on-demand electronics manufacturing services focused on printed circuit board assembly and rapid hardware production workflows. The company offers automated quoting, component sourcing, PCB fabrication, assembly management, and order tracking through a web-based platform that integrates with electronic design automation files. Its manufacturing system supports prototype builds, low-volume production, and batch manufacturing for hardware development teams working in robotics, aerospace, automotive, and industrial electronics. CircuitHub also develops software-driven factory processes and inventory management tools that help customers manage parts procurement, production status, and design iteration cycles.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that automates PCB fabrication and assembly by integrating design files directly with manufacturing processes.
productsAndServices.name: Software-Driven Electronics Manufacturing Platform
